title: Design System: AI Heroes house style, web translation (experiment)

extensions.scope: Documents the experiment's web translation of the AI Heroes house style at /nl/experiment/huisstijl; canonical sources are aiheroes-present/template/DESIGN.md and aiheroes-hub/docs/posttaal.md. Not yet the live site's system.

display-cover-long.purpose: Cover headlines over 40 characters; the punch drops to its own line.

display-m.purpose: Every section heading; width and svh terms so a slide fits a 768px-tall screen.

entry-title.purpose: Titles inside the three colour planes.

stat.purpose: Case figures, tabular, count up on entry.

title.purpose: Contact 'meet us' heading; the standard's four poster lines share its weight.

quote-lead.purpose: The first, larger testimonial; regular weight.

quote.purpose: The other five testimonials, body-on-dark tint.

body-l.purpose: Section ledes, case lede, Groningen claim.

shadows.name: rule-inset
shadows.purpose: Nav bottom rule; inset strokes stand in for borders, there are no drop shadows.

shadows.name: square-close
shadows.purpose: Closes the cover's cream square against the cream section below.

shadows.name: button-hover-ring
shadows.purpose: Ring in the button's original fill colour after it inverts on hover.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for every transition.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Section build-up of data-item children on entry (IntersectionObserver, once).

motion.name: plane-grow
motion.value: 600ms scaleY from bottom, stagger 90ms; content fades in 380ms later
motion.purpose: Entry planes grow like deck bars.

motion.name: icon-draw
motion.value: 700ms stroke-dashoffset after the square rises (500ms), lines 110ms apart
motion.purpose: IconPark line icons draw themselves on entry.

motion.name: photo-open
motion.purpose: Case and place photos open on entry.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: Case figures count up from zero.

motion.name: cover-clock
motion.purpose: The fill end advances the cover slide; pauses on hover, focus, hidden tab, pause button.

motion.name: cover-wipe
motion.purpose: New colour field on a visitor's tab choice.

motion.name: statement-punch
motion.purpose: Slogan punch turns from cream to red after the slide lands.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all transitions and animations none; final states shown; scroll snap off

observedBehaviour: The nav is declared position: sticky; top: 0, but src/styles/global.css sets overflow-x: hidden on html and body, so the bar scrolls away with the page in practice.

narrative.overview:
Every section is one slide class from the deck template or one post preset, stacked vertically: the L01 cover with a photo panel, the entries as a strip of colour fields (post "merkkaart"), L21 quotes on dark with an L15 logo wall, the "Bij elke bouw inbegrepen" poster on blue, the klantcase in numbers, the L09 place photo, a dark statement slide, the L17 contact offer and a closing footer slide. At 1024px and wider each section is literally a slide: at least one viewport tall below the nav, content centred vertically, with proximity scroll snapping between them. There is no scroll pinning and no scroll-driven choreography: sections build up once as they enter and then hold still.

The page is paced, not wall-to-wall colour. Red and blue appear as whole fields in three places only: the cover zone, the blue field of the standard and the contact zone; between them cream and warm-ink slides alternate and colour returns as accent (the three entry planes, red quote marks, the first case figure in red, the blue Groningen claim, the slogan's punch in red). One family, Inter 4.1 variable with optical sizing and the serifed capital I (`cv08`), carries the whole voice through weight: 800 for display, 700 for titles and figures, 600 for actions and labels, 450 for lede, 400 for body and the clients' own words. Surfaces are flat: no gradients, no drop shadows, no glow. Rules and outlines are drawn as 1.5px inset strokes.

Density is low: one heading, one supporting paragraph, one action per slide. Photos never carry text: colour photos sit beside the cover headline, people are duotoned, the real place stays in colour. The cream square, the brand's signature geometry, appears three times: as the dark brand tile in the nav (inverted), as the cover square holding the full-colour wordmark, and as the footer square holding it again.
keyCharacteristics: Four colours; red and blue as whole fields only on the cover zone and the contact zone.
Cream and warm-ink slides in between, colour as accent only.
One family: Inter 4.1 variable, optical sizing on, `cv08` always on.
One module = 1/16 of the viewport (`clamp(24px, 6.25vw, 120px)`); side padding is one module, capped to a 1680px measure.
One viewport per section at 1024px and up, headings scaled by viewport height, with a compaction layer below 840px tall.
Blueprint grid only behind a light zone with little text; no slide uses it at the moment.
The square: brand tile in the nav, wordmark square on the cover, wordmark square in the footer.
One icon set everywhere: IconPark Outline (Apache 2.0) on its 48 grid, stroke 4, square ends, mitred joins, drawn inline so each path can draw itself.
Motion builds each section up once; reduced motion switches every transition, animation and the snap off.

rules.name: The Two Fields Rule
rules.body: Red and blue fill a whole zone only on the cover and on the contact zone. Everywhere else they are accents on cream or ink.

rules.name: The Rotation Keeps The Field Rule
rules.body: Auto-rotation of the cover changes words, subline and photo inside one colour field; only a visitor's tab choice changes the field, by wiping the new colour in from the left (720ms).

rules.name: The Cream Text Rule
rules.body: Text on red, blue or ink is cream; paragraph copy on dark uses the 86% tint, never a grey.

rules.name: The 800 Rule
rules.body: Weight 800 is for display only: the cover headline, section headings and the slogan (plus the red opening quote mark). Titles and figures stop at 700.

rules.name: The One Punch Rule
rules.body: A headline carries at most one emphasised word, a no-wrap `.punch` span; the copy may mark two, the build keeps one.

rules.name: The 76px Threshold Rule
rules.body: On a colour field the punch only turns ink at display sizes of about 76px and up (from 1330px wide for normal headlines, 1660px for long ones). Below that, a long headline's punch drops to its own line instead of changing colour.

rules.name: The Serifed I Rule
rules.body: `cv08` is always on, so "AI" never reads as "Al". Do not swap in a build of Inter that lacks it.

rules.name: The Slide Fits Rule
rules.body: At 1024px and up a section must fit one viewport below the nav on a 768px-tall screen; headings scale with `svh`, and short screens get the 840px compaction layer rather than a scroll inside the slide.

rules.name: The Grid Or Rules Rule
rules.body: The blueprint grid never sits behind running text or row dividers, and only on a light zone with little text; no slide uses it at the moment.

rules.name: The Inset Stroke Rule
rules.body: Lines are 1.5px inset strokes (2px for a focused input), never offset or blurred shadows.

dos: Do keep whole red or blue fields to the cover zone and the contact zone; use colour as accent everywhere else.
Do set every heading in Inter HS with `cv08` on, 800 for display and 700 for titles and figures.
Do keep at most one punch word per headline, and let it change colour on a colour field only at about 76px display size and up.
Do size side padding in modules (`pad-x`) and keep each desktop section to one viewport, scaling headings with `svh`.
Do draw rules and outlines as 1.5px inset strokes in the rule or panel-edge tints.
Do keep text off photos; duotone people, keep places and cover scenes in colour.
Do use the square: nav brand tile at bar height, wordmark squares on the cover and in the footer.
Do build a section up once on entry and give every motion a reduced-motion fallback that shows the final state.
donts: Don't use drop shadows, gradients or glows; depth is colour fields and photos.
Don't round colour zones, photos, planes or squares; radius belongs to controls only (2px, 4px).
Don't put a label or kicker above a heading; emphasis comes from the punch, weight and size.
Don't add scroll pinning, scroll-driven unfolding or a hide-on-scroll nav; sections hold still once built.
Don't let auto-rotation change the cover's colour field; only a visitor's choice does.
Don't use the blueprint grid behind long text or combine it with row dividers.
Don't rely on the nav staying on screen while the global `overflow-x: hidden` on html and body remains; it scrolls away in practice.
